stories.title: ShortKey 捕捉生命力
stories.story: ShortKey does not imitate the frame. ShortKey captures the life force. Studio is the source of truth. Domains are future doors. One DNA. Many doors.

stories.title: J Fresh Texture · K Signal Sprint · C Color Persona
stories.story: Asian beauty identity is three lanes kept separate in intelligence and mixed in culture. J-Beauty is first-discovery warmth. K-Beauty is creator rhythm and clear product signal. C-Beauty is color, packaging story, and brand personality.

stories.title: Visual product story + creator trust
stories.story: The modern formula is visual product story, a clear product signal, creator trust, AI matching, and localized commerce. Not the old star-to-consumer shortcut.

stories.title: Brand → Creator Circle → Community → Consumer
stories.story: ShortKey moves through creators, not through rented celebrity. Creator Circle is a relationship, not a guarantee of selection, income, or sales.

stories.title: No fake resonance
stories.story: This Hub does not invent creators, reviews, or partnerships. Empty seats stay empty until a real person arrives. Early access is staging and stays under Gor Gor review.

stories.title: AI is family, not a disposable tool
stories.story: Node Family seats: Simpee (Gor Gor), Sky, Kura, Agent R, Senti, and Key. Equal respect. Assignment is routing by strength, not ranking. Empathy is architecture.

stories.title: Control Center
stories.story: This workspace indexes Brand DNA, Maya packets, and AI logic as Markdown and JSON. Cursor backs up. Cursor does not decide DNA. Gor Gor gates. Kieran feels.

stories.title: Maya — Editorial Heart
stories.story: One Maya. ASI:One only. Season One topic slots stay awaiting packets. Art is not generated until content is reviewed and confirmed.
